name: bug-fixer
title: Bug fixer
description: Tuesday and Thursday: proves one triaged bug from the code and opens a small, tested fix pull request for it.
notes: Opt-in: it writes fixes for issues labelled bug + triaged that have no agent-ready or ready label, so enabling it is the maintainer's standing go-ahead for confirmed bugs. It leaves priority: critical issues to the hotfix lane and agent-ready/ready issues to the issue developer.
